sql.propToolPricing.getAllForCompany: select p.id, p.pricing, p.company_id, p.archived from props.pricing p where p.company_id = :companyId and p.archived is not true order by p.pricing
sql.propToolPricing.update: update props.pricing set pricing = :pricing where id = :id
sql.propToolPricing.delete: update props.pricing set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
